initialBuild.title: Hunter/Trapping
initialBuild.description:
Everything is in priority order. Trap stats are locked in when a trap is placed, so swap to the SKILLING preset before setting traps or casting [[talent:310]] , then back to DAMAGE before going AFK.

# DAMAGE PRESET

## TAB 1

- [[talent:6]]  -> [[talent:5]]  -> 50 points [[talent:268]]  -> [[talent:269]]  -> [[talent:266]] 

- [[talent:10]]  (only what accuracy needs, STR is Hunter's accuracy stat) -> max [[talent:268]]  -> [[talent:11]]  (come back each time [[talent:293]]  raises its cap) -> [[talent:12]] 

- Optional: 50 points [[talent:9]]  then [[talent:0]]  if you AFK with no healing food

## TAB 2

- [[talent:277]]  -> [[talent:273]]  (cast before going offline) -> [[talent:284]]  -> 25 points [[talent:270]]  = 25 points [[talent:271]] 

- [[talent:276]]  -> [[talent:278]]  -> [[talent:280]] 

- Optional: [[talent:274]]  only if you run prayers that raise mob HP

## TAB 3

- [[talent:305]]  (scales with every 50 items found account-wide) -> 25 points [[talent:300]]  = 25 points [[talent:301]]  (keep both on the attack bar, attack talents multiply AFK damage)

- [[talent:293]]  -> [[talent:307]]  -> [[talent:310]]  (up to 140)

- Skip for AFK: [[talent:302]] , [[talent:303]] , [[talent:304]] , [[talent:309]] 

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 1

- [[talent:620]]  -> [[talent:616]]  (capped at 10% of highest level)

- [[talent:621]]  = [[talent:624]]  = [[talent:627]] 

## STAR TALENTS - Tab 2

- [[talent:638]]  -> [[talent:631]]  -> [[talent:634]] 

- 1 point in both [[talent:635]]  and [[talent:639]] 

- Optional: [[talent:632]] , [[talent:629]] , [[talent:640]] 

# SKILLING PRESET (trap setting)

## TAB 1

- [[talent:263]]  (max) -> [[talent:11]]  -> [[talent:269]] 

- Optional: [[talent:8]] 

## TAB 2

- [[talent:278]]  -> [[talent:276]]  -> [[talent:265]] 

- [[talent:281]]  -> [[talent:282]]  = [[talent:283]] 

## TAB 3
